card: This PR adds Clang lifetimebound annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan overloads for owning containers, allowing compilers to diagnose dangling views created from temporaries. To avoid false positives on valid view types, it splits the helpers using std::ranges::borrowed_range and specializes std::ranges::enable_borrowed_range for leveldb::Slice. It follows up on merged PR 36164, which added similar diagnostics to string helpers in util/string.h.
evidence: Follow-up to merged PR #36164 ('util: diagnose dangling views of temporary strings') as suggested in review discussion.

PR description: 'A temporary container can leave those views dangling. Add LIFETIMEBOUND to the overload taking non-borrowed_range types, so Clang diagnoses the misuse on owning containers without flagging correct code that passes a view.'
problem: MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan return non-owning views into input containers, allowing developers to accidentally bind views to temporary owning objects that immediately dangle without any compiler warnings.
summary: This change adds Clang lifetime annotations to MakeByteSpan and MakeUCharSpan when called on temporary owning containers. It constrains the functions with concepts so that inputs satisfying std::ranges::borrowed_range do not trigger lifetime warnings, and explicitly marks leveldb::Slice as a borrowed range in dbwrapper.
